items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lennie Niehaus played the solo on that

ctx.x: Lennie Niehaus ended up doing that one. There’s a Holman Chart on “Cherokee” that was done for Bird but then later on the “Contemporary Concepts” album Lennie Niehaus played the solo on that.
Really? I thought I played all those arrangements. Bill wrote an original tune called “My Lady” and another one that was a kind of stretch-out piece, I don’t remember what that was called.
